ACME CORPORATION — HUMAN RESOURCES POLICY MANUAL
Document ID: HR-POL-2025-001 | Effective: January 1, 2025 | Owner: HR Department

================================================================================
SECTION 1: ANNUAL LEAVE AND TIME OFF
================================================================================

1.1 Paid Annual Leave
All full-time employees accrue 1.67 days of paid annual leave per month (20 days per year).
Part-time employees receive pro-rated leave based on scheduled hours.
Leave must be requested at least 14 calendar days in advance via the Workday HR portal.
Managers must approve or deny requests within 3 business days.
Unused annual leave above 5 days may be carried forward to the next fiscal year (maximum 10 days).

1.2 Sick Leave
Employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave per year.
A doctor's note is required for absences exceeding 3 consecutive days.
Sick leave does not roll over and is not paid out upon termination.

1.3 Parental Leave
Primary caregivers: 16 weeks fully paid parental leave.
Secondary caregivers: 4 weeks fully paid parental leave.
Parental leave must be taken within 12 months of the child's birth or adoption.
Employees must notify HR at least 30 days before intended leave start date.

1.4 Bereavement Leave
Immediate family (spouse, parent, child, sibling): 5 paid days.
Extended family (grandparent, in-law): 3 paid days.
Additional unpaid leave may be granted at manager discretion.

================================================================================
SECTION 2: REMOTE WORK AND FLEXIBLE ARRANGEMENTS
================================================================================

2.1 Hybrid Work Policy
Eligible employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with written manager approval.
Fully remote arrangements require VP-level approval and annual review.
Core collaboration hours: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM in the employee's local timezone.
Employees must be reachable via Slack and email during core hours.

2.2 Equipment and Stipend
Home office equipment stipend: $500 per year (receipts required).
Company-issued laptop must use ACME endpoint protection and full-disk encryption.
VPN connection is mandatory when accessing internal systems from outside the office.

2.3 International Remote Work
International remote work is limited to 30 calendar days per year.
Prior written approval from HR and Legal is required.
Tax and compliance implications must be reviewed before travel.

================================================================================
SECTION 3: PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT
================================================================================

3.1 Review Cycle
Annual performance reviews are conducted in Q4 (October–December).
Mid-year check-ins are mandatory in Q2.
Review components: self-assessment (20%), manager evaluation (60%), peer feedback (20%).

3.2 Rating Scale
Exceeds Expectations (EE): Consistently surpasses goals; eligible for top-tier bonus.
Meets Expectations (ME): Delivers on all core responsibilities.
Needs Improvement (NI): Below expectations; requires a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP).
Unsatisfactory (U): Immediate PIP or separation may be initiated.

3.3 Promotions
Promotion nominations are accepted during Q4 review cycle only.
Minimum time in role before promotion consideration: 18 months.
Promotion budget is allocated at 8% of department headcount annually.

================================================================================
SECTION 4: COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS
================================================================================

4.1 Salary Review
Merit increases are effective April 1 each year.
Average merit increase budget: 3.5% of payroll.
High performers (EE rating) may receive up to 8% increase.

4.2 Health and Wellness
Medical, dental, and vision coverage begins on day one of employment.
Company pays 85% of employee premium; 60% of dependent premium.
Annual wellness stipend: $600 for gym, mental health apps, or fitness equipment.

4.3 Retirement
401(k) plan with 100% company match on the first 6% of employee contributions.
Vesting schedule: 25% per year; fully vested after 4 years.

4.4 Professional Development
Annual learning budget: $2,000 per employee for courses, certifications, and conferences.
Tuition reimbursement up to $10,000 per year for job-relevant degree programs.

================================================================================
SECTION 5: CODE OF CONDUCT AND COMPLIANCE
================================================================================

5.1 Workplace Standards
All employees must comply with ACME's Anti-Harassment and Equal Opportunity Policy.
Conflicts of interest must be disclosed to HR within 5 business days of identification.
Gifts from vendors exceeding $100 in value must be reported and may be declined.

5.2 Data Handling
Confidential employee data (salary, performance, medical) must not be shared outside HR.
Violations of data privacy policies may result in termination and legal action.

5.3 Mandatory Training
New hire onboarding: 2 weeks including compliance, security, and product training.
Annual refresher: security awareness (due by March 31), anti-harassment (due by June 30).
